title: Universal Life Insurance Rate Band Table: Overloan Charge Rate by Policy Year and Attained Age
content:
The rate at which the overloan protection charge on an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy is figured follows the policy year and the insured's attained age on the charge date.

## Bands

1. **Long-duration band.** A policy in at least policy year **25** whose insured has reached attained age **85** is charged the long-duration charge percentage, **2.5%** (0.025).
2. **Mid-duration band.** A policy in at least policy year **20** whose insured has reached attained age **78**, where the policy does not meet both long-duration conditions (policy year 25 or later with the insured aged 85 or more), is charged the mid-duration charge percentage, **3%** (0.03).
3. **Any other policy** is charged the tier's overloan charge percentage, **3.5%** (0.035) on every tier.

Attained age is the insured's age last birthday on the charge date; policy year 25 begins on the twenty-fourth policy anniversary and policy year 20 on the nineteenth.

## Combinations (hypothetical)

| Policy year on the charge date | Insured's attained age | Long-duration conditions both met? | Rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| 25 | 85 | Yes | 2.5% |
| 27 | 91 | Yes | 2.5% |
| 26 | 80 | No (age below 85) | 3% |
| 22 | 86 | No (policy year below 25) | 3% |
| 20 | 78 | No | 3% |
| 24 | 84 | No | 3% |
| 22 | 77 | No | 3.5% (age below 78) |
| 19 | 90 | No | 3.5% (policy year below 20) |
| 16 | 76 | No | 3.5% |

## Points of judgement

- Both conditions of a band must hold together.
- A policy meeting both long-duration conditions also meets both mid-duration conditions, and is charged 2.5%.
